review_candidates.description: Focus Area: African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), Rules of Origin, and Trade Facilitation About the Role We are seeking an expert Trainer and Facilitator based in Nairobi to design and deliver an executive training program on the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) . The program is built for trade practitioners, private sector executives, customs professionals, and policymakers. It moves beyond high-level policy theory to focus on operational reality: helping businesses turn preferential market access into actual, compliant cross-border trade. Key Responsibilities Deliver Modular Training: Facilitate interactive sessions covering the core training modules, including the AfCFTA operational framework, Rules of Origin (Roof), Regional Value Chains (RVCs), and Non-Tariff Barriers (NTBs). Guide Practical Exercises: Lead participants through hands-on case studies—such as origin calculations, HS classification mapping, and end-to-end shipment tracing from factory floor to import clearance. Bridge Theory and Application: Help attendees distinguish between legal agreements, rules, compliance procedures, and real commercial outcomes, ensuring participants grasp that market opportunity does not equal tariff opportunity alone . Facilitate Dynamic Discussions: Direct structured conversations around institutional bottlenecks, supply chain sourcing decisions, the Guided Trade Initiative (GTI), and the strategic role of digital trade systems. Key Topics You Will Cover AfCFTA Operational Reality: Navigating Agreement >Rules >Procedures > Institutional Capacity > Business Application. Rules of Origin (RoO): Teaching wholly obtained goods, sufficient transformation, value addition, cumulation, and origin verification using WCO and AfCFTA Secretariat guidelines. Supply Chain & Sourcing: Connecting procurement and production decisions directly to origin qualifications and regional value chain integration. Origin Documentation & Verification: Guiding participants through evidence-based origin claims, production records, and audit readiness. Tariffs and Market Access: Integrating the AfCFTA E-Tariff Book with logistics, standards, NTBs, and financing conditions. Customs Modernization & Trade Facilitation: Mapping shipment friction points across borders, transit systems, and digital platforms. The Guided Trade Initiative (GTI): Exploring pilot corridors, real-world bottlenecks, and lessons learned from actual shipments. Non-Tariff Barriers (NTBs): Dissecting technical, administrative, and sanitary requirements that affect market access despite zero-tariff privileges. Digital Trade & Emerging Tech: Assessing how AI, blockchain, and electronic certificates solve specific trade friction problems. Candidate Requirements Subject Matter Expertise: Deep, practical knowledge of the AfCFTA agreement, WCO Rules of Origin, trade facilitation, customs procedures, and regional economic integration in Africa. Professional Background: Minimum 5+ years of experience working within trade policy, customs administration, export-import businesses, trade law, or economic development consulting. Facilitation Experience: Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering engaging professional training programs, workshops, or executive education modules. Location: Based in Nairobi, Kenya (or with established local availability for in-person delivery). Skills: Excellent communication, cross-cultural facilitation, and the ability to translate complex legal and technical frameworks into actionable business strategies. How to Apply Please submit your Curriculum Vitae (CV) along with a brief outline or portfolio of similar trade-related training modules you have designed or facilitated to partner@forelitetraining.com
